messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — I'm opening a GCP support case to request a temporary GPU increase on project redwood-preprod. Need +20 A100-80GB in us-west1 for perf runs next week. I'll paste the case number when created.

Priya Patel: what's the current quota in us-west1? do we need whole VGPU counts or specific SKUs?

Sam Ortiz: current per-region A100-80GB = 4 in us-west1, 12 across other regions. We need to hit 24 in us-west1 for canary. delta = +20.

Jordan Lee: timeline? seeing if we can shift tests if this drags.

Alex Chen: timeline = Monday 09:00 PT originally, but can move to Tue if needed. Plan: 6h smoke with full load, then scale down. Cost approved under infra perf budget.

Alex Chen: Created case with GCP — case number 1845678901. Summary: quota increase request for A100-80GB GPUs in project redwood-preprod (us-west1). Asked for expedited review. Internal link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/1845678901

gcp-support: Thanks Alex. Case 1845678901 assigned to the specialist team (SR-672341). Please provide a concise justification and expected duration of the increase. Also confirm billing account and any org policy constraints.

Maria Gomez: tagging sales for visibility — @sales FYI on preprod burst. Also reminder to use non-prod data only.

Priya Patel: justification copy: "temporary perf validation for deployment; non-prod data only; requesting 24 GPU units for 6 hours; will revert after test." added to the case. GCP asked for billing account verification.

Sam Ortiz: quick check command I ran: `gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project redwood-preprod` to confirm quotas.

Alex Chen: Pasted the justification and attach a short run plan. GCP replied asking to confirm billing account ID.

gcp-support: We show billing account not linked to this project. Please link billing account ID BID-00987 or provide billing admin contact. If you can supply PO/contract details we can QuickEscalate.

Sam Ortiz: @Priya can you link the billing account? I don't have the perms.

Priya Patel: I have billing admin — linking now. done, just updated the project billing.

Alex Chen: Updated case with billing confirmation and attached a cost estimate screenshot.

gcp-support: Update: provisional quota increase granted to 24 A100-80GB in us-west1 until 2026-07-20T00:00Z. Permanent increase requires business review. Case SR-672341 updated; ETA for full approval ~48h. Reference: 1845678901.

Jordan Lee: great — can we move the perf test to Tue to give buffer?

Alex Chen: moved to Tue 10:00 PT. I'll post a final go/no-go 24h prior.

Maria Gomez: Also we hit ephemeral IP limits last time — please check VPC external IP quotas before the run.

Sam Ortiz: noted. checklist: 1) GPU quota (provisional) 2) external IP quota 3) subnet IP ranges 4) firewall rules.

Alex Chen: opened a follow-up case for external IPs: case 1845678902 — need +30 ephemeral external IPs in us-west1 for preprod test. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/1845678902

gcp-support: Received case 1845678902. Assigned SR-672342. External IP quota increases usually process in 6-12 hours after billing confirmation.

Priya Patel: could we use Cloud NAT to reduce external IP need? pros/cons?

Sam Ortiz: We could but switching adds NAT config and could alter observed latencies. For performance fidelity we prefer direct external IPs during load tests.

Alex Chen: TL;DR — provisional GPU increase granted, external IP case opened, schedule moved to Tue. I'll confirm final go/no-go 24h before the run.

Maria Gomez: :thumbsup:
